question: Which among the following is the oldest vedas?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Rigveda** is considered the oldest among the **four Vedas**.
 
• It is an ancient collection of hymns and sacred verses composed in Sanskrit and is the **oldest text of Hinduism.**
 
• The Rigveda is believed to have been composed between **1500 and 1200 BCE**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samaveda: **

 
 
• The Samaveda is one of the **four Vedas and is considered the second oldest.**
 
• It is primarily a collection of melodies or **musical chants derived from the hymns of the Rigveda. **
 
 
 
• **Yajurveda: **
 
 
• **The Yajurveda is the Veda** that contains the rituals and procedures to be followed during religious ceremonies and sacrifices.
 
• It is divided into two main sections: **the "Black Yajurveda" (Krishna Yajurveda) and the "White Yajurveda" (Shukla Yajurveda).**
 
• The Yajurveda provides instructions and mantras for** performing rituals, including sacrificial offerings.**
 
 
 
• **Atharvaveda: **
 
 
• The Atharvaveda is the fourth and final Veda.
 
• The Atharvaveda contains hymns addressing a wide range of topics, **including prayers for health, charms against diseases, incantations for prosperity, and rituals for household matters. **
